snippet.title: Hello Kitty ❤ PAC-MAN
snippet.description:
PAC-MAN is now FREE TO PLAY! Play the arcade classic, check out the new MAZES mode, and compete against the world in Tournaments!

Download for free now:

Android: http://bit.ly/1m3BTvP
iOS: http://apple.co/2cTdRng


Eat all of the dots to advance to the next stage. Go for high scores and higher levels! Gain an extra life at 10.000 points! Gobble Power Pellets to weaken ghosts temporarily and eat them up before they change back. Avoid Blinky, the leader of the ghosts, and his fellow ghosts Pinky, Inky, and Clyde, or you will lose a life. It’s game over when you lose all your lives.

2015 World Video Game Hall of Fame Inductee

NEW!!!
• Upgraded user interface that provides an authentic feel and smooth playing experience
• The PIXELS pack of three new mazes challenges you to play like a movie star! o PIXELS – The movie in the game! o MINI – The red ghost plays a naughty car in the new movie. o PINKY – Don’t let them catch you!

CLASSIC PAC-MAN:
So accurate you’ll try to jam in a quarter. Pixel perfect!

TOURNAMENTS:
• FREE play every day!
• Bonus Rounds for extra lives
• Packed with more mazes 
• New Tournaments all the time
• Over 100 Bonus Targets
• Cool multipliers to ramp up your score

MAZES:
Check out the new mazes and add them to your collection!

ACHIEVEMENTS:
Now EVEN MORE Achievements!

LEADERBOARDS:
Challenge your friends! Challenge the world!
